goals: Contribute the exact audited literal block and accessory families to Clutter No More ShapeMap so approved material forms can share one interchangeable storage family.
Preserve Clutter No More as the sole switching, transmutation, recipe-cleanup, and equivalence authority while keeping component patches and source variants exact.

Keep exact accepted C3 live as the rollback baseline while C7 preserves the C6 literal Building But Better detail-family compatibility surface, requires BBB without a BBB version restriction, and remains runtime-untested.
scope: Preserve the existing literal catalog while extending the canonical Fence/Fence Gate and Iron Bars families in place and adding exactly 19 mutually disjoint BBB detail families, yielding 153 families, 1,317 unique item IDs, and a 22-member maximum without suffix, tag, or provider-name inference.

Use BBB's current main registry as the provider authority: 12 wood Trim/Balustrade/Support/Pallet families, 12 matching Frame/Lattice fence extensions, seven exact stone Column/Urn/Moulding/Fence/Frame families, and BBB Iron Fence; retain Mossy Oak as its existing real Ribbits fence/gate pair.

Preserve pre/post ShapeMap collision validation, equal-component-patch equivalence, fail-closed transfer validation, audited alternate-door loot narrowing, recipe cleanup contracts, Quick Stack Nearby affinity, and large-family viewport handling.

Retain exact historical C4 and exact accepted/effective-rollback C3 artifacts; C6 can replace only the same-project C4 Slot B member after a serialized manager preflight that also satisfies the BBB provider dependency.

exclusions: Clutter No More owns ShapeMap, selection controls, 1:1 transmuteCopy switching, recipe equivalence and cleanup, and the graph consumed by Quick Stack Nearby; IBF does not add a second registry, switcher, keybind, networking protocol, recipe engine, or storage-equivalence system.

Minecraft, Macaw, and Dramatic Doors providers own native blocks, placement, collision, redstone, recipes and costs, drops, copper weathering, waxing, scraping, and lightning behavior; IBF does not normalize or replace those semantics.

Nibaru and Block Geometry Extensions own geometry and material behavior, while Quick Stack Nearby and its compatibility layer only consume Clutter No More affinity; IBF does not modify, duplicate, or bundle those projects.

Partial provider materialization, dynamic discovery, registry-name or tag inference, cross-material or cross-finish collapsing, and Macaw paving/full/slab/stair forms remain outside the audited contract.
C7 may replace only the same-project C4 Slot B member through the serialized Test Instance Manager workflow; it must not alter Slot A, the accepted baseline, or the protected gameplay profile.
Legacy status READMEs, provenance and audit narratives, historical C1/C2 matrices and binaries, manager records, snapshots, branches, worktrees, and Git history are not imported.
